warnings: This paper focuses on cadmium reduction, not Zn biofortification - Zn concentration is secondary outcome
Multiple Zn application methods (soil ZnSO4, foliar Zn-EDTA) with different rates
Some treatments combine Zn with other fertilizers (KCl, UAN) - extract only pure Zn treatments
Paper has two separate trials with different designs and treatments
Control is 'Untreated control' - clearly defined as no fertilizer application
Zn rates differ between soil (12 kg Zn ha-1) and foliar (1.1 kg Zn ha-1) applications
Multiple cultivars tested - each cultivar x treatment combination is separate observation

recon.treatment_definition: Zn fertilizer treatments: ZnSO4 at 12 kg Zn ha-1 broadcast at planting, or Zn-EDTA at 1.1 kg Zn ha-1 foliar application at various growth stages
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Some treatments combine Zn with other fertilizers (KCl, fungicides, UAN) - only extract pure Zn treatments vs untreated control
recon.sample_size_source: All treatments in both trials were replicated four times
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract from Table 3: ZnSO4 treatment (27.8 mg/kg Zn) and Zn-EDTA treatment (29.1 mg/kg Zn) vs Untreated control (25.4 mg/kg Zn). From Table 4: Extract various Zn-EDTA timing treatments vs Untreated control (32.3 mg/kg Zn). Each cultivar provides separate observation. Use LSD(0.05) values for variance. Focus only on pure Zn treatments, exclude combination treatments with KCl or other fertilizers.
